title: San Juan Rafa
style: Rap with soul swagger and jazz-soul color, mid-tempo swung head-nod with dusty drum pocket and elastic bass; verses ride tight internal rhyme, pre-chorus opens with sung ad-libs and clipped pauses, chorus hits with a chantable two-line hook and stacked doubles. Male vocals, close-mic and gritty, with Spanish-English call-and-response, sax flourishes between lines, tape-worn textures, and a bright punchy mix with warm low end., jazz, soul, rap
